figurative_meaning_en: Daily routine tasks or obligatory duties
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রতিদিন সকালে তার নিত্যকর্ম শেষ করে অফিসে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He finishes his daily routine tasks every morning before going to the office.
In Hinduism, daily religious duties are of utmost importance.
history: Refers to the concept of 'Nitya Karma' in Hindu scriptures like the Vedas and Dharma Shastras, denoting obligatory daily rituals.
note: Primarily used in religious contexts but extends to general daily routines in modern usage.
